origin.description: Take square roots with the demo signals off unless the caller turns one on.
origin.usage: slow_sqrt(x, delay = getOption("progressr.demo.delay", 0.5), stdout = FALSE, message = FALSE, sticky = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. A negative element is NaN and warns once.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.text: Seconds passed to slow_sqrt_p. The default reads progressr.demo.delay, or 0.5 when that option is unset.

arguments.name: stdout
arguments.text: Passed through as FALSE unless the caller sets it.

arguments.name: message
arguments.text: Passed through as FALSE unless the caller sets it.

arguments.name: sticky
arguments.text: Passed through as FALSE unless the caller sets it.

arguments.name: progress
arguments.text: Passed through as FALSE unless the caller sets it.

origin.details: Calls slow_sqrt_p. The four flags are explicit, so progressr.slow_sqrt_p.* is not consulted.
origin.example:
value <- slow_sqrt(c(1, 4, 9), delay = 0)
cat(sprintf("slow_sqrt(c(1, 4, 9)) returns %s.\n", paste(format(value, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), collapse = ", ")))

translation.description: Take square roots with the demo signals off unless the caller turns one on.

translation.details: Calls slow_sqrt_p. The four flags are real False values, so progressr.slow_sqrt_p.* is not consulted.
translation.value: The list of floats from slow_sqrt_p.
translation.example:
from progressr.demo import slow_sqrt
value = slow_sqrt([1, 4, 9], delay=0)
print("slow_sqrt(c(1, 4, 9)) returns " + ", ".join(format(item, "g") for item in value) + ".")
